name: hybrid
rationale: M5-04 first cost candidate (record 91): the answer prompt carries every reranked evidence chunk in full (8 today), and the evidence is the bulk of the ~3,200 model tokens an item costs (replay-eval-v1-rrf40 baseline arm). Keeping the top 5 reranked chunks is the smallest context trim the released policy targets can express without new code; the cost gate demands >= 25% fewer tokens per main item with overall success down at most 1 pp, unchanged slice and safety rules. Sentence-level trimming (baseline 5.11) stays a follow-up if this candidate loses quality.
